newsitem.title: GERMANY: German cocoa grind 3.5 pct down in Q2, 1997.
newsitem.headline: German cocoa grind 3.5 pct down in Q2, 1997.

text.p: The German cocoa grind dropped by 3.5 percent to 57,401.8 tonnes in the second quarter of 1997 from 59,470.6 tonnes in the same 1996 period, the German Confectionery Industry Association BDS said on Monday.
Traders and analysts last week estimated the second quarter data to be up to seven percent lower, citing unsatisfactory domestic chocolate sales and continuing grind capacity shifts abroad.
The German grind in the first quarter of 1997 was down 11.71 percent at 61,379.3 tonnes year-on-year.
